findings.quote: Check that a diploid cell has two alleles of the gene.
findings.problem: The rationale assumes that diploid cells have two alleles of any gene. Male human diploid cells have only one allele of most X-linked genes. The stem does not restrict the gene to an autosome. A single allele fails to show heterozygosity because heterozygosity requires two different alleles, not because diploidy guarantees two copies of every gene.
findings.source: [National Cancer Institute, Dictionary of Genetics Terms: hemizygous](https://www.cancer.gov/publications/dictionaries/genetics-dictionary/def/hemizygous)
